p = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u093/system/state/workspace/programs/task-24c6d316.py')

source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for r in range(h):
            src_r = h - 1 - r if tile_r in (0, 2) else r
            row = []
            for tile_c in range(2):
                cells = grid[src_r]
                row.extend(cells[::-1] if tile_c == 0 else cells)
            out.append(row)
    return out
'''

exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), ns)
